title: Spindle Load — Elevated Baseline
description: Spindle load P002 baseline on operation {val} is {val2}% above historical mean for same program. No acute spike. Gradual trend suggests accumulating mechanical resistance.
probable_cause: Tool wear progression, slight bearing preload increase, or minor misalignment.
diagnostic_steps: Compare current cycle time to nominal
Inspect tool visually for chip edge
Run dry cycle (spindle only, no feed) and check no-load current
remedy: Schedule tool inspection at next shift change. Log in maintenance history.
required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.
escalation_path: If SPN-MD-001 is not addressed (log fault. schedule maintenance within 24 hours. reduce feed rate by 20%.), the fault will escalate in this order: SPN-SR-001, then SPN-WN-004. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
